response.title: which dehumidifier is the cheapest to run all year
response.answer:
The cheapest dehumidifier to run year-round is usually an ENERGY STAR Most Efficient compressor-based model, rather than a mini dehumidifier or a thermoelectric (Peltier) model.

But the best choice depends on how much moisture you need to remove.

For a bedroom or living room: An efficient 20–35 pint/day compressor dehumidifier is often the most economical.

For a damp basement or large space: An efficient 50-pint/day model can be cheaper overall because it removes more water per kWh.

For cold spaces (below about 60°F): A desiccant model may work better, but typically costs more in electricity.

The important metric is Integrated Energy Factor (IEF), measured in liters of water removed per kWh. Higher is better.

Specific models worth considering

According to ENERGY STAR's published efficiency data, these are among the most efficient portable models in the roughly 45–50 pint/day class.
